title: FileStore behind the local GraphQL proxy
description:
Purpose: Replace the local GraphQL proxy's PostgresStore with a file-backed Store so FastAPI is the only process required for small-scale local use.

Postgres remains valid for Kubernetes / non-AWS deployments. DynamoDB remains valid for AWS. This epic is the third backend: documents on disk.

Do not implement until file layout, concurrency, and which companion servers (object store, vector store) are in or out of "FastAPI only" are agreed.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Virtuus file-backed store is on develop (#612). Postgres remains the default.
